name: Dawdle
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 immediate action
Components V, S, M (a snail)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Dawdle causes a creature to suffer a -4 circumstance penalty to its initiative and a -1 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves.
